workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Validation

on: push

jobs:
  style-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9"]

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/agno

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade \
            pip setuptools wheel \
            ruff mypy pytest types-pyyaml
          pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
      - name: Ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format .
      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check . --target-version py39
      - name: Confirm mypy version
        run: |
          mypy --version
      - name: Mypy
        run: |
          mypy .

  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Run dev setup
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/dev_setup.sh

      - name: Pin zep-cloud to working version
        run: |
          VIRTUAL_ENV=.venv uv pip install --force-reinstall "zep-cloud==2.22.1"

      - name: Run tests for Agno
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest --cov=agno --cov-report=json:coverage-agno.json ./libs/agno/tests/unit
          echo "AGNO_COVERAGE=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("coverage-agno.json"))["totals"]["percent_covered_display"])')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}

workflow:
name: Main Workflow

on: push

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Ensure latest release tag merged
  # -------------------------
  ensure_latest_tag_merged:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ensure latest release is merged in develop2 branch
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git fetch --tags --prune

        latest_tag=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n1 || true)

        if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
          echo "No tags found, skipping tag merge check."
          exit 0
        fi

        if git rev-parse --verify origin/develop2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Checking that branch 'develop2' contains the latest release tag: $latest_tag"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$latest_tag" origin/develop2
        else
          echo "Branch origin/develop2 not found. Skipping check in fork."
          exit 0
        fi

  # -------------------------
  # 2. Determine Python versions (Linux only)
  # -------------------------
  set_python_versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python_versions_linux: ${{ steps.set_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux }}
    steps:
    - name: Determine Python versions
      id: set_versions
      run: |
        # For your fork / validation, you can just use 3.10.
        # If you really want branch-specific logic, you can re-add it later.
        echo 'python_versions_linux=["3.10"]' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # -------------------------
  # 3. Linux Tests
  # -------------------------
  linux_tests:
    needs: [ensure_latest_tag_merged, set_python_versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.set_python_versions.outputs.python_versions_linux) }}
        test-type: [unittests, integration, functional]
        include:
        - test-type: unittests
          test-name: Unit
        - test-type: integration
          test-name: Integration
        - test-type: functional
          test-name: Functional
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.test-name }} (${{ matrix.python-version }})
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Cache pip
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt') }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r conans/requirements.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_dev.txt
        pip install -r conans/requirements_server.txt
        pip install meson

    - name: Run tests
      uses: ./.github/actions/test-coverage
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        test-type: ${{ matrix.test-type }}
        tests: test/${{ matrix.test-type }}
